partnersPage.metaDescription: Hotels, restaurants, transport companies, guides, museums and experience hosts across Uzbekistan join Gulistan Travel to meet travellers who are planning their trip.
partnersPage.title: Grow your business with travellers planning Uzbekistan
partnersPage.lead: Gulistan Travel connects local hotels, restaurants, drivers, guides and hosts with travellers at every step of their journey — from the first idea to the last dinner in Bukhara.

typeText.hotel: Boutique hotels, family guesthouses, mountain lodges and yurt camps.
typeText.restaurant: Plov centres, teahouses, rooftop dining and family kitchens.
typeText.transport: Airport transfers, drivers, minibuses and intercity cars.
typeText.tour_operator: Local operators running day tours and multi-day routes.
typeText.guide: City, heritage and mountain guides in many languages.
typeText.museum: Museums, galleries and craft collections that welcome visitors.
typeText.attraction: Viewpoints, parks, observatories and places to visit.
typeText.experience: Cooking classes, craft workshops and evenings with local hosts.

partnersPage.whoText: Any travel business in Uzbekistan that welcomes visitors and can confirm requests from our travel managers.

partnersPage.ecoTitle: Where your business meets the traveller
partnersPage.ecoText: Travellers use Gulistan Travel at every stage of the trip. Partner profiles, services and prices appear exactly where decisions are made.

eco.discoverText: Destination pages, travel guides and the AI guide inspire the trip.
eco.exploreText: The travel map and virtual tours show hotels, food and sights side by side.
eco.planText: The trip constructor adds your hotel, restaurant or tour to a day-by-day plan.
eco.bookText: Requests reach our travel managers, who confirm the details with you.
eco.navigateText: Transfers, trains and drivers connect every stop of the route.
eco.experienceText: Guests arrive at your door, enjoy the visit and share their reviews.

benefits.b1: Travellers who are ready to go
benefits.b1Text: Inquiries come from people who are planning dates, routes and budgets — not just browsing.
benefits.b2Text: Your listing sits on an English, Uzbek and Russian site, next to the destinations travellers search for.
benefits.b3Text: Our travel managers qualify each request and pass you the details you need to confirm.
benefits.b4Text: Your services can be added to tailor-made tours and trip plans, together with transport and guides.
benefits.b5Text: Follow your application status, listings and the inquiries you receive in one place.
benefits.b6Text: A team in Uzbekistan who know the cities, the seasons and the way guests travel here.

how.s1Text: Tell us about your business and add your main services with indicative prices.
how.s2Text: Our team checks the details and may ask a few questions. You can follow the status in your dashboard.
how.s3Text: Once approved, your profile appears in the partner directory and next to the right destinations.
how.s4Text: Inquiries arrive through our travel managers, who confirm dates, prices and details with you.

partnersPage.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No partners} one {# partner} other {# partners}}
partnersPage.modelsText: Joining the network and receiving inquiries is free for partners while we grow. The revenue models below are planned for the next stage of the platform.

models.commissionText: A transparent percentage on confirmed bookings made through the platform — partners pay only when a guest actually travels.
models.featuredText: Priority placement on destination pages, the travel map and in trip plans for partners who want more visibility.
models.subscriptionText: Monthly plans with extended profiles, photo galleries, seasonal offers and more listings.
models.advertisingText: Clearly marked promotions for tourism brands and regions in guides, newsletters and the AI guide.
models.insightsText: Anonymised demand reports — popular dates, routes and traveller origins — for partners and tourism authorities.

partnersPage.ctaText: The application takes about five minutes. Our team will contact you after the review.

profile.listingsText: Hotels, restaurants and transport options run by this partner.
profile.inquiryText: Your message goes to our travel manager, who arranges the details with {name} and replies to you.
profile.priceNote: Prices are indicative “from” prices. Availability and the final price are confirmed by our travel manager.

apply.title: Become a Gulistan Travel partner
apply.lead: Tell us about your business. After a short review your profile appears in the partner directory and our travel managers start sending you guests.
apply.side1: You receive a reference number and a private dashboard link right away.
apply.side2: Our team reviews your application and may contact you with questions.
apply.side3: Once approved, your profile is published and inquiries start to arrive.
apply.servicesHint: List your main services with an indicative “from” price in US dollars. Leave the price empty if it is always on request.
apply.descriptionHint: What makes your place special, where it is, languages spoken, seasons (at least 30 characters).
apply.consent: I confirm that I represent this business and agree that Gulistan Travel may store these details to review the application and contact me.
apply.doneTitle: Thank you — your application is in
apply.doneText: Your reference is {reference}. Our team will review the details and contact you.
apply.dashboardText: Use this link to follow the status and update your services while the application is reviewed. Keep it private: anyone with the link can open the dashboard.

dashboard.title: Partner dashboard
dashboard.notFoundText: The link is incomplete or no longer valid. Please use the full link you received after applying, or contact our team.

statusText.pending: Our team is reviewing your application. You can still update the description and services below.
statusText.approved: Your profile is live in the partner directory. Inquiries from travellers appear below.
statusText.rejected: Your application was not approved. Please read the note from our team; you are welcome to apply again.

dashboard.placesEmpty: No hotel, restaurant or transport listings are linked yet. Our team links them after approval.
dashboard.inquiriesText: Inquiries about your profile and listings. Our travel managers handle the customer contact and confirm the details with you.
dashboard.editLocked: Editing is available while the application is under review. To change an approved profile, contact our team.

preview.title: Built together with local businesses
preview.text: Hotels, restaurants, drivers, guides, museums and experience hosts across Uzbekistan — one network that takes travellers from discovery to the last dinner of the trip.
